newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Average yield in Slovak c.bank O/N repo 26.34 pct.
newsitem.headline: Average yield in Slovak c.bank O/N repo 26.34 pct.

text.p: Average yield in the National Bank of Slovakia's (NBS) overnight repo tender on Tuesday dipped to 26.34 percent from 26.56 percent in a similar tender on Monday.
The NBS said it accepted only the offered fixed volume of 7.5 billion crowns, out of bids totalling 9.916 billion crowns.
On Monday, the NBS offered and accepted a fixed volume of 5.0 billion crowns.
The NBS did not release further details of the operation.
